summary: Completed Module 04-05 Interlude reflection on the 2019 Cloudflare regex incident, connecting adversarial input resilience, error sanitization, and blameless postmortems to production system design.
evidence: Identified unexpected input vectors (malformed JSON, injection payloads, oversized URLs, token tampering) and defined API defenses: Pydantic schema validation, centralized exception handling, sanitized client errors, and structured logging.
Explained the core principles of blameless postmortems: diagnosing systemic and pipeline gaps rather than individual blame, fostering engineering trust, and driving automated safeguards.
